# Periwinkle v2 re-skin · user app and admin panel: design

Date: 2026-11-18 · Status: **draft for the owner's review** (written while the owner is away; every open question is
settled below as a "Ruling" so the build is not blocked) · Scope IDs: cross-cutting UI work. It touches the screens of
**U1, U2, F1** (app) and **A1, A2, A4** (admin) and changes no behaviour. Design decision **D2** (Periwinkle, v2 chosen
2026-11-18).

**Follows:** the approved brief `docs/mockups/user-app-mockup-periwinkle-v2.html`, generated by
`docs/mockups/src/build-periwinkle-v2.mjs` (tokens at lines 775–793 and 1284–1285, component CSS at 794–1371, screens
at 266–770). **Textile:** the project rule says to start from the textile project's matching spec and code, but
`E:\textile-marketplace` is **not on this machine** (checked 2026-11-18: no `E:` drive). Textile also has no matching
work: it applied a different theme ("Clean Bench") to its own mockup only. So this spec works from this repo: the
mockup source, `apps/user-app` (`lib/ThemeContext.tsx`, `lib/theme.ts`, `components/*`, `navigation/tab-navigator.tsx`,
`screens/**`) and `apps/admin` (`tailwind.config.ts`, `app/globals.css`, `components/**`). The format follows
`2026-11-18-f1-a2-business-profile-verification-design.md`.

**Labels:** **[Brief]** taken from the v2 mockup. **[Repo]** from the codebase or `CLAUDE.md`. **[Claude]** the author's
call. Each [Claude] call that changes what the owner will see is written as **Ruling (Rn)** and collected in §13.

---

## 1. Intent

`CLAUDE.md` names Periwinkle v2 as the UI brief for every screen, but the built app still wears the base theme ported
from textile: indigo `#4F46E5`, Montserrat + Inter, shadowed cards, outlined inputs, uppercase field labels and a stock
tab bar. The admin uses Tailwind's indigo and grey with Onest and a dark sidebar. Every new feature screen (listings, F2
onwards) will be built straight in v2, so the tokens, fonts and components have to be v2 first, or each feature
re-skins its own corner.

This build changes **how things look, not what they do**. It re-skins every existing app component and screen, adds the
small v2 components those screens need, swaps the fonts, and restyles the admin kit so its pages match the four admin
mockup screens. Two guard tests keep it that way: the palettes are checked against the mockup's CSS variables, and a
style audit fails the build on a hard-coded colour.

**Success check:** with the app on a dev build, every screen in §12.3 matches the mockup's look in light and dark, in
English, Hindi and Gujarati. In the admin, Dashboard, Business verification and Categories & machine types read like
mockup screens 11.1, 11.4 and 11.3. `pnpm typecheck`, `pnpm lint` and `pnpm test` pass, the app bundles with
`expo export`, and no test ID, analytics label, API call or translation changed.

---

## 2. Goals, non-goals, anti-goals

### Goals
- **App tokens**, light and dark, taken one for one from the mockup's CSS variables, with a test that compares them. **[Brief]**
- **Fonts:** Manrope (400–800) and JetBrains Mono (400, 500) in the app and the admin; a type scale from the mockup. **[Brief]**
- **Every existing app component** restyled to v2, plus the v2 pieces the current screens need: Card, ListRow,
  StatusChip, SegmentedControl, OtpCells, Steps, IconButton, FooterBar, Field, a floating tab bar, and the welcome art
  (SideToken, GearShot, HeroGlow). **[Brief]**
- **Every existing app screen** restyled: welcome, phone, OTP, your business, where are you, the GST screens, profile
  and the five tabs. **[Repo]**
- **Admin:** tokens (Tailwind palette), fonts and the UI kit restyled so the existing pages match mockup screens
  11.1–11.4. No layout rewrites. **[Brief]**
- **Guards:** palette parity tests (app and admin) and a style audit that fails on hard-coded colours (§11). **[Claude]**

### Not in this build

| Left out | Comes with |
|---|---|
| New features and new screens: listings, home grid, search results, chat, offers, deals, notifications, saved, requirements, rental, seller dashboard, the listing page, product photos | Each feature, built in v2 from the start (F2–F9) **[Owner]** |
| Copy changes, new strings, the welcome's "Browse without signing in" link and language line | Guest browsing (M2); language on welcome is a later UX call. No locale file changes in this build **[Owner]** |
| Admin layout rewrites: the mockup's top search bar, role chip and two-pane layouts on pages that don't have them | Each admin module when it's built **[Owner]** |
| Admin dark mode | Later. Dark values are listed in §4.4 so it can be switched on without new decisions **[Claude]** |
| New app icon, splash art, brand name | D1 (name and logo) is still open with the client **[Repo]** |
| A web build of the user app | Not supported today (§12.2); not added for a visual check **[Claude]** |
| Bundled Noto Sans Devanagari / Gujarati | Only if the device check in §5.3 fails (contingency described there) **[Claude]** |

### Anti-goals: this fails even if it technically works when
- A screen behaves differently: a different navigation, validation, API call, toast, analytics event, `testID` or
  `phLabel`. **[Repo: analytics and e2e selectors depend on them]**
- A colour is written outside the palette files, or a dark-mode surface shows a light colour (today's `Skeleton` is
  `#ebe9f0` in both themes). **[Brief]**
- Hindi or Gujarati text is clipped, crowded or loses its weight hierarchy. **[Repo: `lib/i18n/script.ts`]**
- The floating tab bar covers content or a button on any tab screen. **[Claude]**
- Violet is used for decoration. It's for actions and selection only. **[Brief]**
- An admin test that checks a class name (`bg-brand-600`, `text-red-600`) has to be changed to pass. **[Repo]**

## 3. What the mockup is, and how its numbers become app numbers

The mockup draws each phone at **300 × 640 CSS px with a 9 px bezel** (content is 282 px wide), so many phones fit on
one page. Real Android phones are 360–412 dp wide, and the scope's NFRs ask for large text and ≥ 44 pt tap targets for
traders with low digital comfort. Taken one to one, the mockup's 13 px body text and 32 px chips would be too small.

**Ruling (R1): app measurements are the mockup's × 1.15, rounded, with tap targets of at least 44 dp.** 1.15 is close to
345 / 300, between the mockup's width and a mid-size phone. The tables in §5 and §7 already give the scaled numbers, so
the builder never computes them. Two existing values already sit on this scale (button height 52 = 46 × 1.13, header
56 = 50 × 1.12), so the app's proportions barely move. **The admin is 1 : 1**: its mockup frame is drawn at desktop
size (a 232 px sidebar against the admin's 240 px).

**Spacing:** the existing scale stays (`xs 4, sm 8, md 12, lg 16, xl 20, xxl 24, xxxl 32`). Mockup values snap to it:
3–5 → `xs`, 6–8 → `sm`, 10–12 → `md`, 14 → `lg`, 16–18 → `xl`, 20–22 → `xxl`, 28–30 → `xxxl`. **Screen side padding
becomes 16 (`lg`)**, from 24 today (the mockup's `.pad` is 14). **[Claude]**

**Radius** (replaces `lib/theme.ts` `radius`):

| Token | dp | Used for (mockup) |
|---|---|---|
| `xs` | 6 | Mono tag (`.pn`) |
| `sm` | 10 | Segment inside a segmented control (`9`) |
| `md` | 14 | Fields, segmented track, skeleton blocks, small thumbs, icon wells (`12–14`) |
| `lg` | 18 | Callouts, choice cards, toasts, map box (`16–18`) |
| `xl` | 24 | Cards, menus, list cards (`20–22`) |
| `sheet` | 28 | Bottom sheet top corners (`28`) |
| `full` | 999 | Buttons, chips, pills, tab bar, avatars |

### 4.2 Old tokens and what replaces them

`ThemeColors` keeps only the names in §4.1. The removed names fail `pnpm typecheck` wherever they're still used, which
is how the migration is enforced. **Batch 1 renames every call site mechanically** (table below), then Batches 2–3 pick
the right token per component and screen.

| Old token | Replaced by | Old token | Replaced by |
|---|---|---|---|
| `card` | `surface` | `green` / `greenMuted` | `ok` / `okSoft` |
| `elevated` | `field` | `red` / `redMuted` | `danger` / `dangerSoft` |
| `border` | `border` (same name, now `--line`) | `orange` / `orangeMuted` | `warn` / `warnSoft` |
| `borderLight` | `divider` | `blue` / `blueMuted` | `primaryInk` / `primaryWash` (info is violet in v2) |
| `primaryLight` | `primarySoft` | `white` | `onDanger` (its only use is text on the red button) |
| `primaryMuted` | `primaryWash` | `black` | removed (unused) |
| `primaryDark` | `primaryInk` | `focusFill` | `surface` (a focused field turns white) |

`lib/gst-flow.ts`'s `ChipTone` follows: `green | orange | red | muted` becomes `ok | warn | danger | neutral`.

### 4.3 Shadows

v2 replaces card shadows with hairline borders. Shadows remain only on things that float. **Ruling (R2): shadows use
React Native's `boxShadow` style** (RN ≥ 0.76, New Architecture, which `app.json` enables), so the CSS values carry over
exactly. They're defined once in `palette.ts` and returned by `useTheme().shadows`:

| Name | Value (light / dark colour per §4.1) | Mockup | Used by |
|---|---|---|---|
| `raised` | `0 2px 8px <shadow>` | `.iconbtn` | IconButton (raised), header back button |
| `float` | `0 8px 22px <shadow>` | `.footbar`, `.buybar`, `.tabbar` | FooterBar, tab bar, toast, welcome art |
| `segment` | `0 1px 3px rgba(28,20,70,.14)` light, `0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,.5)` dark | `.segmented span.on` | Selected segment |

`cardShadow` and `primaryGlow` are removed (cards don't cast shadows; v2 buttons don't glow). Android before 9 draws no
`boxShadow`; that's accepted because cards rely on borders and the floating pieces still read as floating.

## 5. Typography

### 5.1 Families and weights

| Use | App (`fonts.*`, `@expo-google-fonts/*`) | Admin (`next/font/google`) |
|---|---|---|
| Body, 400 | `regular` `Manrope_400Regular` | Manrope, variable `--font-sans` |
| Leads, descriptions, 500 | `medium` `Manrope_500Medium` | |
| Field values, list rows, 600 | `semiBold` `Manrope_600SemiBold` | |
| Titles, buttons, chips, labels, 700 | `bold` `Manrope_700Bold` | |
| Prices, display, badges, OTP digits, KPIs, 800 | `extraBold` `Manrope_800ExtraBold` | |
| Identifiers, 400 / 500 | `mono` `JetBrainsMono_400Regular`, `monoMedium` `JetBrainsMono_500Medium` | JetBrains Mono, `--font-mono` (Tailwind `font-mono`) |

Montserrat and Inter are removed from the app (`@expo-google-fonts/montserrat`, `@expo-google-fonts/inter`); Onest
from the admin. `fonts.display`, `displaySemi` and `displayHeavy` go (Batch 1 renames them to `bold`, `semiBold`,
`extraBold`). **Never `fontWeight`** in the app: Android ignores it for a custom family, so the weight is picked by the
family name. The style audit enforces it (§11.2). **[Repo: existing rule, now checked]**

### 5.2 Where JetBrains Mono goes

**Ruling (R5): mono is for identifiers people read or copy character by character**: GSTIN (typed and shown), PAN,
part numbers (later), the admin's catalogue keys, slugs and paths (they already use `font-mono`), and reference codes.
**Not** for phone numbers, pincodes, prices or OTP digits: the mockup sets those in Manrope (`.phonefield`,
`field('Pincode', …)`, `.otp i`). When a GSTIN sits inside a translated sentence ("GSTIN: {{gstin}}"), the sentence is
split around the value (`splitOnValue`, §7.6) so only the GSTIN is mono. The copy doesn't change. Shown inline, the
mockup's `.pn` tag: `monoMedium`, 0.9 × the surrounding size, `field` fill, radius `xs`, padding 1 × 6.

### 5.3 Hindi and Gujarati

Manrope has no Devanagari or Gujarati glyphs. The mockup's stack is `Manrope, Noto Sans Gujarati, Noto Sans
Devanagari`: Latin in Manrope, Indic glyphs in Noto.

**What the app does today:** it loads Montserrat and Inter only, and the OS draws Indic glyphs from its fallback fonts
(`lib/i18n/script.ts`: "Montserrat has no Gujarati or Devanagari, so the system font draws them"). On Android the
system fallback for both scripts **is Noto Sans Devanagari / Gujarati**. On iOS it's Kohinoor Devanagari / Gujarati
Sangam.

**Ruling (R6): keep system fallback; don't bundle Noto.** Reasons:
1. On Android (the launch platform) it reproduces the mockup exactly: Manrope for Latin, digits and ₹, Noto for the
   Indic glyphs, per glyph. Bundling Noto and switching `fontFamily` by language would do worse: React Native can't
   chain custom fonts, so in Hindi mode prices, GST, OTP and brand names would also render in Noto instead of Manrope.
2. It costs nothing: no download, no extra `useFonts` wait at boot. The four Noto weights for two scripts would add
   about 2 MB.
3. It's what already ships, so the hi/gu screens the owner has seen don't change family.
4. iOS (second platform) gets Apple's Indic fonts, which suit the platform.

**Script rules, now in the type scale** (§5.4, pure function `typeStyle(token, lang)`, tested):
- Line height in hi/gu is at least 1.45 × the size (existing `scriptLineHeight`).
- Negative letter spacing becomes 0 in hi/gu (existing `scriptTracking`): v2 tracks titles at −0.02 to −0.03 em, which
  breaks joined Indic letters.
- **800 drops to 700 in hi/gu** (the mockup's `.lang-gu … {font-weight:700}`), so heavy Indic headings don't clot.

**Contingency (only if the device check fails):** if, on the owner's Android device, hi/gu headings don't look bolder
than body text (the fallback ignoring the typeface weight), add `@expo-google-fonts/noto-sans-devanagari` and
`@expo-google-fonts/noto-sans-gujarati` (400, 600, 700) with `npx expo install`, and make `typeStyle` return the Noto
family for the script. The switch lives in that one function, so it's a one-task change. The checklist in §12.3 has
the exact thing to look at.

## 6. Colour rules (v2 restraint)

From the brief, applied to every component and screen:
- **Violet (`primary`, `primaryInk`) only for actions and selection**: primary buttons, links, selected chip / row /
  segment / tab, focus, the filled side half, progress. Icons in list rows and section titles use `primaryInk` (the
  mockup's `.menu` first icon), and that's the only decorative use.
- **Lavender fills** (`primaryWash`, `primarySoft`) mark selection and informational callouts.
- **Yellow (`sun`) is for badges only**, never buttons.
- **Cards are `surface` with a 1 dp `hairline` border and no shadow.** Inputs, idle chips and tracks are `field` fills
  with no border.
- **Status colour only on status:** `ok` for verified or done, `warn` for waiting, `danger` for errors. Each is used as
  text or icon on its `*Soft` fill.

## 7. App components

Measurements are in dp. Every component keeps the contract in `user-app/CLAUDE.md` §2.1 (theme from `useTheme`,
memoised styles, a `style` prop, tokens only, no copy) and keeps its current props, `testID`s and behaviour unless a
row says otherwise.

### 7.1 Controls

| Component | v2 rules |
|---|---|
| **Button** (`components/Button.tsx`) | Pill (`full`). Sizes: `lg` 52 high (default, standalone), `md` 48 (inside FooterBar), `sm` 36 (auto width, `hitSlop` 4). Padding x 20 (`sm` 14). Label `button` (`sm`: `buttonSm`). Optional leading `icon` (18; `sm` 16), gap 8. Variants: **`primary`** `primary` fill, `onPrimary` label; **`outline`** (the mockup's `.btn.ghost`) `surface` fill, 1.5 `border`, `text` label; **`ghost`** no fill, `primaryInk` label (text links); **`danger`** (new) `danger` fill, `onDanger` label. Disabled 0.45 opacity. Press spring unchanged. No glow. `lg` and `md` are full width unless placed in a row. |
| **Input** (`components/Input.tsx`) | **Filled** (`.f-v` v2): `field` fill, radius `md`, min height 52, padding x 16, value `fieldValue` in `text`, placeholder `textMuted`. A 2 dp border is always there in the fill colour, so focus doesn't shift layout. **Focused:** `surface` fill, `primary` border. **Error:** `danger` border, message `caption` in `danger` 6 below. Label above: `label` in `textSecondary`, sentence case (the uppercase + 0.8 tracking goes), 6 above the field. New props: `prefix` (text before the value, `textSecondary`, with a 1 dp `hairline` divider and 12 gap, used for `+91`), `size="lg"` (min height 60, `phone` type), `mono` (family `monoMedium`, tracking 1). `InputComponent` (bottom-sheet input) kept. |
| **Field** (new `components/Field.tsx`) | Label + children + optional hint + optional error for anything that isn't a text input (chip groups, lists). Label and error as Input; hint `caption` `textMuted`, 6 below. Input uses the same label and error styles. |
| **Chip** (`components/Chip.tsx`) | `.chip` v2: `field` fill, no border, min height 40 (tap target; the mockup's 32 × 1.15 = 37), padding x 14, label `chip` in `textSecondary`. Selected: `primarySoft` fill, `primaryInk` label and icon. Icon 16. Disabled 0.5. |
| **SegmentedControl** (new) | `.segmented.big` v2. Track: `field`, radius `md`, padding 4, gap 2. Segments: flex 1, min height 44, radius `sm`, label `chip` in `textSecondary`. Selected: `surface` fill, `shadows.segment`, `primaryInk` label. Roles: track `radiogroup`, segment `radio` with `selected`. Props `options: { value, label, testID }[]`, `value`, `onChange`. |
| **OtpCells** (new) | `.otp` v2: `length` cells in a row, gap 8; each flex 1, height 58, radius `md` + 2, `field` fill, digit `otp` in `text`. The **current** cell: `surface` fill and a 2 dp `primary` border. **Error:** every cell gets a 2 dp `danger` border. One real `TextInput` sits over the row (absolute, transparent, caret hidden) and keeps today's props (`autoComplete="sms-otp"`, `textContentType="oneTimeCode"`, `number-pad`), so autofill, paste and Hindi / Gujarati digits work as they do now. Cells come from pure `otpCells(raw, length)` (§7.6) built on `otpFieldState`. Tap anywhere focuses the input. |

|---|---|

Backdrop is `scrim`, its opacity animated 0 → 1 (`use-sheet-animation` output changes from `[0, 0.5]` to `[0, 1]`, since the colour carries the alpha). **Buttons become `Button`**: a two-button row (`outline` cancel, `primary` or `danger` confirm, flex 1); the stacked form (confirm, `outline` secondary, `ghost` dismiss). Each `phLabel` is the current `ph-label` value, which makes them `testID`s too. Choice cards (`picks`): `.choice` v2, radius `lg`, 1.5 `hairline` border, padding 12; selected `primary` border + `primaryWash`; radio 20 with a 2 `border` ring, selected a 6 `primary` ring; amount `price` at 16 in `ok`. |

### 7.4 Welcome art

| Component | v2 rules |
|---|---|
| **HeroGlow** (new) | The `.welcome` background: a `react-native-svg` `RadialGradient` from the top-left (radius 120 % × 70 %), `heroGlow` at 0 to `background` at 0.7, drawn absolutely behind the screen. (`react-native-svg` is already installed; RN's own gradient backgrounds are experimental.) |
| **GearShot** (new `components/art/GearShot.tsx`) | The mockup's `PARTS.gear` and its gradients (`g-steel`, the `g-sh` floor shadow) ported to `react-native-svg`, on a sweep from `surface` to `photo` (`.thumb`). Size 172, radius 30, `shadows.float` (the mockup's `.thumb.big` 150 / 26). Decorative (`accessible={false}`). Its metal colours are illustration, not theme, so `components/art/**` is on the style audit's allowlist. |
| **SideToken** (new) | `.side .tok`: two halves, gap 2, each `md` 20 / `lg` 28 / `xl` 40 square. The left half's outer corners are round (`full`) and the inner ones radius 4; the right half mirrors it. The letter (`L`, `R`) is the `badge` type at 11 (`xl`: 17). Half states, from pure `sideHalves(kind)` (§7.6): `on` `primary` / `onPrimary`; `off` `photo` / `textMuted`; `have` `textMuted` / `surface`; `need` `primaryWash` with a 1.5 dashed `primary` border and `primaryInk` letter (RN can't draw the mockup's hatch; **Ruling R7**). No text label in this build: labels need copy and come with listings. |

**Ruling (R8): the welcome screen gets the mockup's art** (GearShot plus a `want-right` SideToken in `xl`, over
HeroGlow). It's the brand moment of the brief, and SideToken is needed by every listing screen anyway, so building it
now with tests isn't wasted. It's decorative and changes no copy or behaviour.

### 7.5 Tab bar (`navigation/floating-tab-bar.tsx`, new; used via `tabBar` in `tab-navigator.tsx`)

`.tabbar` v2: a floating pill, absolutely placed with a 16 margin either side and 12 + the safe-area inset at the
bottom; `surface`, radius `full`, padding 8, `shadows.float`; tabs spread evenly.

- Tab: 44 circle, icon 22. Inactive `textMuted`. Active: `primaryInk` icon on a `primaryWash` well.
- **Post** (the mockup's "Sell"): always a 52 circle in `primary` with an `onPrimary` `Plus` (24, stroke 2.4), active
  or not. The icon changes from `PlusCircle` to `Plus` (added to `lib/icons.ts` and its mock).
- Bar height 68. `useTabBarInset()` (`hooks/use-tab-bar-inset.ts`) returns 68 + 12 + the bottom inset + 8 and **every
  tab screen pads its scroll content or body bottom by it**. The arithmetic is a pure `tabBarInset(bottom)` in
  `lib/tab-bar.ts`, tested.
- The bar's root view is `position: 'absolute'`, so screens draw full height under it.
- It hides while the keyboard is open, using its own `Keyboard` listener (the stock `tabBarHideOnKeyboard` option only
  applies to React Navigation's built-in bar).
- **Ruling (R9): icon-only, as the mockup** (it has no labels). Each tab keeps its translated name as
  `accessibilityLabel` (`nav.tabs.*`) and gets a `testID` (`Tab-home`, `Tab-search`, `Tab-post`, `Tab-chats`,
  `Tab-deals`). If the owner wants labels back for traders with low digital comfort, it's one flag in the tab bar
  component (labels in `caption` under the icons, bar height 76).

| File | Function | Rule |
|---|---|---|
| `lib/palette.ts` | `lightColors`, `darkColors`, `TOKEN_SOURCE`, `NOT_PORTED`, `shadowValues(isDark)` | §4.1, §4.3 |
| `lib/typography.ts` | `typeStyle(token, lang)` | §5.3, §5.4 |
| `lib/otp-cells.ts` | `otpCells(raw, length): { char: string; state: 'filled' \| 'current' \| 'empty' }[]` | Digits from `otpFieldState`; the first empty cell is `current`; when complete, the last is `current` |
| `lib/side-token.ts` | `sideHalves(kind): { left: HalfState; right: HalfState }` | Port of the mockup's `side()`: `left` → on/off, `right` → off/on, `pair` → on/on, `want-left` → need/have, `want-right` → have/need, `none` → off/off |
| `lib/split-value.ts` | `splitOnValue(text, value): [before, value, after] \| null` | Splits a translated sentence around an interpolated value (GSTIN in mono, §5.2); `null` when absent |
| `lib/tab-bar.ts` | `TAB_BAR_HEIGHT`, `tabBarInset(bottomInset)` | §7.5 |

| 11.4 Business verification (A2) | `components/verification/review-queue.tsx`, `review-detail.tsx` | Queue `rounded-[20px]`; selected row `.q.on` as the tree row; detail specs table (`.specs` v2): `rounded-2xl border border-gray-200`, `dt text-gray-400 font-semibold`, `dd font-extrabold text-right`, row dividers `gray-200`; actions right-aligned pills. |

## 11. Guards

### 11.1 Palette parity tests
- **App** `apps/user-app/lib/palette.test.ts` reads `docs/mockups/src/build-periwinkle-v2.mjs`, collects every
  `:root{…}` and `[data-theme="dark"]{…}` block in order (later blocks win, as in CSS) and asserts, for both themes,
  that every `TOKEN_SOURCE` entry equals the mockup value (hex compared case-insensitively, `rgba` with spaces
  removed). Every mockup variable is either in `TOKEN_SOURCE` or `NOT_PORTED`, so a new mockup variable fails until
  someone decides. `lightColors` and `darkColors` have the same keys.
- **Contrast** (same test, WCAG formula): ≥ 4.5 : 1 for `text` and `textSecondary` on `background`, `surface`, `field`;
  `onPrimary` on `primary`; `onSun` on `sun`; `onDanger` on `danger`; `primaryInk` on `primaryWash` and
  `primarySoft`. **≥ 3 : 1** for `textMuted` on `surface` and `background`, and each status colour on its soft fill.
  **Ruling (R15):** the approved palette is kept even though `textMuted` (3.3 : 1 on white) and the light-theme status
  pairs (`ok` 3.5, `warn` 3.6, `danger` 3.8) are under AA's 4.5 for small text. They're used for secondary text and for
  12 dp chips in the 800 weight. If the owner wants AA, the text-only darker values are ready: `ok #0F7A50` (4.7), `warn
  #8F5900` (5.2), `danger #C02C36` (4.8), `textMuted #6F6C80` (5.1). Each is a one-line change in `palette.ts` plus the
  test's floor; the dark theme already passes AA.
- **Admin** `apps/admin/lib/palette.test.ts`: the same parser; asserts every anchor in §4.4's first table (light
  column).

### 11.2 Style audit (hard-coded colours)

**Ruling (R16): a Vitest test, not a lint rule.** The user app has no ESLint (`pnpm lint` is admin-only), and the
app's i18n audit (`lib/i18n/audit.ts`) already scans the source with the TypeScript AST from a test. Same pattern, same
place, runs in `pnpm test`.

- **App** `lib/style-audit.ts` (pure `auditStyles(file, source): Finding[]`) + `lib/style-audit.test.ts` (fixture cases
  plus "the app is clean", scanning every `.ts` / `.tsx` outside `node_modules`, `__mocks__` and test files). Flags, in
  string literals and template text: hex colours (`#rgb`, `#rgba`, `#rrggbb`, `#rrggbbaa`), `rgb(`, `rgba(`, `hsl(`;
  named colours (`white`, `black`, `red`, … the CSS named colours) as values of any `*Color` / `color` property or prop;
  any `fontWeight`; any `fontFamily` given a string literal (must be `fonts.*` or a type token). `transparent` is
  allowed. Allowlist `lib/style-audit-allowlist.json` (`{ file, reason }`), starting with `lib/palette.ts` (the
  palette) and `components/art/` (illustration materials).
- **Admin** `lib/style-audit.ts` + `lib/style-audit.test.ts` over `app/`, `components/`, `lib/` (`.ts` / `.tsx`):
  flags hex colours and `rgb(` / `hsl(` in strings, Tailwind arbitrary colour values (`-[#…]`, `-[rgb(…)]`; the
  `shadow-[…rgb(…)]` in Tabs is the one allowlisted exception), and Tailwind colour families outside the palette
  (`slate zinc neutral stone orange yellow lime emerald teal cyan sky blue indigo violet purple fuchsia pink rose`).
  `lib/palette.ts` is exempt; `tailwind.config.ts` and CSS aren't scanned.

## 12. Verification

### 12.1 Automated (every batch ends green)
- `pnpm typecheck`, `pnpm lint`, `pnpm test`. The app's i18n parity and audit tests must stay green with **no
  locale file changes**. Baseline before Batch 1: user app 162 tests in 19 files (2026-11-18); admin and API counts are
  recorded at the start of Batch 1.
- New tests: palette parity + contrast (app, admin), typography, otp-cells, side-token, split-value, tab-bar, style
  audits (app, admin), the updated `gst-flow.test.ts`.
- `cd apps/user-app && CI=1 npx expo export --platform android` bundles (Metro resolves the new font assets);
  `CI=1 npx expo install --check` is clean.
- `pnpm --filter admin build` passes (`next/font` fetches Manrope and JetBrains Mono at build time).

### 12.2 Can the app be checked in a browser?
**No.** `expo start --web` needs `react-native-web` and `react-dom` 19, which aren't installed. The app also uses
modules with no web build (`react-native-maps`, `expo-secure-store`). Adding a web target (dependencies plus shims) is
a feature, not part of a re-skin. **Ruling (R17): the app's visual check is screenshots on a dev build, by the owner**,
using the checklist below. The existing dev client works: no native module is added (fonts load through `expo-font`
at runtime, and `react-native-svg` is already in the build). `pnpm start:user` and reload.

### 12.3 Owner's visual checklist (app)
Do a full pass in **English light** and **English dark**, then the script passes: **Hindi light** and **Gujarati
dark**. Compare with `docs/mockups/user-app-mockup-periwinkle-v2.html?only=onboarding` and `?only=account` (add
`&theme=dark`).

| Screen | Look for |
|---|---|
| Welcome | Glow from the top-left; gear on a white sweep with a soft shadow; L \| R token with R dashed; display title |
| Phone | Filled field with `+91` and a hairline divider; floating white footer pill with the violet button |
| OTP | Six filled cells; the current one white with a violet ring; error turns all cells red-ringed; paste and SMS autofill still fill the cells |
| Your business / Where are you | Steps bar; sentence-case labels; filled inputs that turn white with a violet ring on focus; quiet grey chips, lavender when selected; area list with a lavender selected row |
| GST intro, start, found, declare, code, review form, status (each state) | Lavender callout; GSTIN in JetBrains Mono, typed and in the details card; status chips green / amber / red on soft fills; dashed violet add tile for documents |
| Profile | Grey avatar tile; GST chip; meter; row icons in violet; language list; Light / Dark / System segmented control, the selected segment white with violet text |
| Home, Search, Post, Chats, Deals | Floating pill tab bar, icon-only, the Post button a violet circle; the active tab a lavender well; **the last content and empty-state buttons are never under the tab bar**; the keyboard hides the bar |
| Confirm sheet (Log out) | Purple-tinted scrim, white sheet with 28 corners, red destructive button |
| Toasts (save a profile; an error) | White card, hairline, soft shadow, green or red icon well, draining rail |
| Loading states | Skeletons are grey-lavender in light and dark navy in dark (not a light block in dark mode) |
| **Hindi and Gujarati** | No clipped matras or descenders in titles, buttons, chips, fields, toasts; titles visibly bolder than body text (**if they aren't, apply the §5.3 contingency**); tab-bar accessibility labels translated |

### 12.4 Admin visual check (browser)
`pnpm dev:api` + `pnpm dev:admin`, sign in with the seed admin, and compare side by side with
`user-app-mockup-periwinkle-v2.html?only=admin`: **Dashboard** ↔ 11.1, **Business verification** (with a review open)
